notes.title: Update notes for 2023.11.10
notes.content:
Hello fellow dwarven smiths!

As the subtitle indicated, this is our last scheduled update for Forge Industry. We feel the game is in a good enough state with plenty of QoL features added, and bugs squashed since release. Continuing to develop on Forge Industry isn't feasible in regards to return on invest. Thus here is a final update that adds some more QoL features (and some more bugs squashed!)

Without further ado, the changelog:

Features:
[list]
[*] Buildings have updated visuals to reflect their storage space. So when a refinement station has plenty of ore and ingots in it's inventory, the building visual will reflect this by showing filled barrels. Every building will have this implemented in one way or another, to add a bit more liveliness to them.
[*] Preview items being transported in a route. If you hover over the route name in the route overview, you'll get a preview of the items being transported in that route.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed market orders not making use of the timespan (updated localisation for timespan to be more clear as well)
[*] Fixed default save names containing illegal characters in windows
[*] Fixed workshop's interaction with scabbards, allowing you to reliable sheath your swords away and improving the safety of the world!
[*] Fixed an issue with default keybindings for German keyboards.
[*] Localisation changes
[/list]


What does it entail for our future? We're not dropping out of Game Development, in fact, we're just going to go deeper in it! We've been spending the past month or so towards our next project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2581260/Songs_of_Everjade/]Songs of Everjade[/url]. It's a game in an entirely different direction to test the waters to find what we enjoy making. We've learned plenty during the process of making Forge Industry, like what things to do, and what things [i]not[/i] to do, which we'll be utilising in our future projects.

I want to add a heartfelt thank you from the BiteMe Games team for anyone that bought our game, and continues to buy it. May you all have a good time ːlunar2019piginablanketː

notes.title: Update notes for 2023.10.13
notes.content:
GameForce Belgium and Netherlands was exhausting but resulted in plenty of feedback and motivation to keep BiteMe Games going. Below is a list of QoL changes and bugfixes that we got out of the GameForce feedback on both weekends, resulting in an even smoother game experience. 

As an extra bonus, a highly requested feature of allowing to edit which buildings a route will deliver to, or even adding more steps to a route, is now supported if the route is paused. When you pause a route, and all the workers have finished running their steps, you'll be allowed to change the buildings and add or remove steps from the route.

[strike](Note, the update for mac will be delayed for a day as there are issues with building, but you should also be getting your updates soon!)[/strike]
Update: MacOS and Demo builds are now both also live.

[b]Additions ⭐[/b]
🤩 Added new tutorial steps for buying your first Iron Ore and Coal.
🤩 Holding shift while using WASD to move your camera around will increase the speed.
🤩 Added titles and descriptions for Wildcards in the route selection dropdown.
🤩 Added a visual indicator on the minimap to show the North.
🤩 Architect Atelier will now remember last selected research during a session.
🤩 Added the ability to pause from the route overview window, by pressing on the pause/play icons.
🤩 Marketplace can no longer be placed on top of roads, this was a design choice, but ended up being very confusing for players.
🤩 When saving the game, you will now receive a default timestamp as name.
🤩 Abandoned Architect Atelier will now allow you to show all routes connected to it.
🤩 The Architect Atelier research entries will now show a wiki button if there is a wiki entry for it.
🤩 When a route is paused, it's now editable. A route will be counted as paused if all the workers working on that route have reached their last step.

[b]Bugfixes 🪲[/b]
🐛 Fixed marketplace (and other windows) their scroll views starting halfway down in some cases.
🐛 Editing a route during the tutorial will now appropriately recheck the condition.
🐛 Freeing up a worker from a route will now attempt to reassign them to buildings requesting workers.
🐛 Rotating the camera with ALT+WASD will now correctly register for the tutorial.
🐛 On a new route window, the second step that defaults to "No Item" will no longer show the tooltip for the first item in the list.
🐛 Implemented additional null checks to prevent some exceptions that got thrown.
🐛 Potential fix/handling for certain hard crashes that had to do with returning to main menu.
🐛 Made sure that the button to clear what item to carry in a route step always shows up when needed.
🐛 Fixed that the Architect Atelier couldn't be moved through the context menu.
🐛 Toasts will now correctly start closing if there are more than 3.
🐛 Route overview screens now get updated correctly if a route gets removed.
🐛 Pressing escape will now close all windows, and act in a more consistent manner.
🐛 Pausing through the shortcut, and then opening the Pause Menu through escape, lead to a wonky state, this now gets handled correctly.
🐛 Radial menu now works while paused.
🐛 Workers will now discard their boxes when you clear their inventory.
🐛 Routes that you have open in the Route Window will now recheck if they are valid, whenever you place down a new road.
🐛 The sell item toggle will now correctly hide when you remove the last marketplace step from the route steps.
🐛 Market orders will now take into account their quantity, to display the full price.
🐛 Lamp posts can now be researched.
🐛 Various exception handling, based on received crash reports.
🐛 Various localization improvements.

notes.title: Update notes for 2023.09.28
notes.content:
A few small changes, but some important ones nonetheless. With the last update, we added a reworked tutorial, with the support for highlighting specific elements on the screen to help the players navigate our UI... a feature that didn't actually work in our published builds. With this update, players will now notice highlights in the UI and in the world, to indicate what is important for the current tutorial step.

Furthermore, there was an issue in our configuration for bug reports. This update should send us any bug reports upon crashes now, allowing us to further research what's causing some of the crashes out there.

Additions ⭐

🤩 Extra wiki entries and tooltips
🤩 Random worlds now get a unique random seed every time, instead of our own preset seed which you can alter.

Bugfixes 🪲

🐛 Fixed our new tutorial not correctly highlighting buildings and UI elements
🐛 Fixed an incorrect calculation in how long routes take
🐛 Fixed a UI glitch when completing a tutorial step whilst closing the tutorial popout

notes.title: Update notes for 2023.09.05
notes.content:
A common complaint was that our tutorial was... 'lacking', to put it nicely. Or 'terrible' to put it bluntly. We took that feedback, looked at areas where we could improve it, and thus have reimplemented the tutorial. Amongst the many new and changed steps we've added, we also added the ability to highlight buildings and UI buttons during certain steps, to help guide new players through starting a new playthrough.
We hope this guides players through the first steps of the game. Saves remain compatible. If you were doing the tutorial in a save, it'll reset back to the first step, using our new tutorial. (It may prompt you to make a new route with Iron Ore for example, as some things weren't tracked yet before this update.)

Additions ⭐

🤩 New tutorial
🤩 Workers now hold a crate when they are transporting an item.
🤩 Radial menu for buildings now has a quick create route option. Using this option will put you into the "select building" mode for the second step in the route, upon which you can select a new building. Using this, you can quite quickly create simple routes between two buildings.
🤩 Added a clear item button to route steps, so that you can quickly remove an item from being transported.
🤩 Show a new route button in the routes overview, when no routes have been created yet.
🤩 Timescale has been adjusted, there are now only 3 speed options (1x, 2x and 4x), but 1x is now the old 2x, 2x is the old 4x and 4x is the old 8x.

Bugfixes 🪲

🐛 Route duration is now displayed correctly in seconds
🐛 Fixed some animation transitions for workers.

notes.title: Update notes for 2023.08.21
notes.content:
Hello blacksmiths!

The addition list may seem small, but behind the scenes it contains a large rewrite of how our milestones worked. What are milestones, you say? Milestones are achievements and the tutorial system, I answer.

This means currently, a lot of bugs regarding milestones are fixed, allowing you to progress further and unlock some previously inaccessible steam achievements. This also means that the upcoming tutorial rewrite will be able to leverage the strength of our new milestone system to be more expansive and concise, helping aspiring blacksmiths on their path to glory.

I now really hope there is no glaring oversight or bug I missed ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Additions ⭐

🤩 Reworked certain UI elements to be more clear
🤩 Reworked milestone system from ground up, for a more expansive achievement system.
Bugfixes 🪲

🐛 Reworked milestone system from ground up, for a bugfree experience.

notes.title: Update notes for 2023.08.14
notes.content:
Hello blacksmiths!

Now that you've been having a few weeks to try out the game, and sharing your feedback with us, we're finally starting to implement some (much-needed) UI/UX changes on top of squashing bugs.

We are aiming for a weekly update cycle for at least the next month, where we overhaul some of the biggest pain points. Your feedback is invaluable, so do keep sharing your feedback with us through the Steam Discussions, or our Discord server.

As a sneak peak, for next week we will be focusing mostly on making our game easier to understand, with a completely reworked tutorial system, as this seems to be where most beginning players struggle, as we don't explain the mechanics of the game clearly enough as of now.

Also, if you did buy the game, we'd love if you are able to take 3 minutes of your time to write us a review on Steam, it would greatly help us with the Steam algorithm.

Best of luck forging!

[h2]Additions ⭐[/h2]
🤩 Added more tooltips to explain certain buttons.
🤩 Separated the Music & Ambient sounds channels. You can now hear ambient sounds at all time while playing music, if you so choose.
🤩 Added more variety to the ambient sounds per biome.
🤩 You will no longer be able to select items to deliver to buildings that can't accept items. (eg. Mine, Quarry, ...)
🤩 Added scroll bars to the game and graphics option windows.
🤩 Increased readability of tooltips.
🤩 Updated icons to be more clear in their meaning. 
🤩 Updated the look of the Milestone tooltip (we are aware certain milestones aren't behaving correctly, and are working on resolving this by next update). 
🤩 Improved German localizations.
🤩 Improved general UI layout and readability.
🤩 Added Unity Diagnostics so we can better resolve crashes you may get. 

[h2]Bugfixes 🪲[/h2]
🐛 Fixed certain Birch items (such as scabbard, pommel, cross guard incorrectly being displayed as Oak in English.  
🐛 Fixed Lumberyard having 2x Move button.
🐛 Workbench will now no longer crash on load when you have an optional part selected.
🐛 Kiln's floating popup now is no longer half embedded in the kiln from certain angles.
🐛 Fixed some weird interactions between mine and refinement station in routes.
🐛 Searching in item/recipe inputs now works again.
🐛 Fixed Recreation Area lights being in the wrong position.

notes.title: Forge Industry is now available!
notes.content:
I'm incredibly happy to announce that after 18 months of hard work, Forge Industry is now completely available.

Forge your destiny as a blacksmith! Automate your workshops, optimize your supply chain, research new materials, craft legendary weapons, and cast your place in the world. 

We've spent the past 18 months working on this game, and are incredibly proud of the result. A big thank you to everyone who played our game during Steam Next Fest and provided feedback as well. 

As we decided not to do early access, what can you still expect of upcoming updates?
- Bugfixes & Balancing
- You can expect a QoL improvement at a later date as well, giving us some time to get your feedback about which parts are bugging you
- We are currently not planning any new major features. We believe that the game as it is right now, is in a good place. However, we may still add more content at a later point (items, milestones, events, requests, decor buildings,...)

Now head on out and forge your destiny! And if you do end up buying a copy of the game, know that you help us out immensely by leaving a review as well.
